  0 < s →
    s ≤ n →
      w ≤ OracleTemplate.BirchMethods.cycleLength n s →
        ∑ u ∈ Finset.Ico a (a + w),
            OracleTemplate.BirchMethods.cycleGroup n s (u % OracleTemplate.BirchMethods.cycleLength n s) ≤
          n
